text_block_list.text:
Four times a year, special competitions
known as tryouts are held at
Tracen
Academy. Here, trainers gauge the
potential of talented
students.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All are welcome as spectators, whether
they are an academy student
or a racing
fan. This time, all of the trainers' eyes are
on one runner in
particular.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To reach the upper echelons of the
Twinkle Series and to achieve a
first-place
victory in the Tenno Sho—these are my
goals as a Mejiro.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I'll show you all exactly what I'm capable
of during this tryout race!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family is rich with a history of
top-class runners, and I hear
that
McQueen is their most promising
up-and-comer. I'm lookin'
forward to this.
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Even before entering the Academy, she's
made a name for herself as
a talented
stayer. I'm eager to see just how far she's
honed her skills!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Her flowing hair a striking ashen hue,
Мэдзиро МакКуин has captured
the
attention of many.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, McQueen! Our group's up next. Let's
get over to the gates!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Thank you, Ines Fujin.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Let's make haste!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин's tryout race is under
way, and things aren't looking
good for
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The runners are fast approaching the finish
line, but Мэдзиро МакКуин
lingers at the
rear!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Geh!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She can't seem to catch up... Has she run
out of steam?
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's not quite matching her
reputation as a stayer, but maybe
we were
expecting too much.
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text: Wheeze, wheeze...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She's giving it her all, but she can't catch
up!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin leads the pack... and crosses the
finish line!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin has won the tryout race! The
shouts heard echoing across
the track are
sure to follow her for years to come!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Hehe, thanks, everyone! Your cheers are what carried me to first place!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
A good pair of legs on her, that Ines Fujin.
I bet that she could be an
absolute beast
given the right training regimen.
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text: Right. I'd love to have her on our team!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Today's supposed star, though... She didn't
quite hit the strides I
thought she would.
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Tch... How shameful!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
With Мэдзиро МакКуин placing seventh,
Ines Fujin completely steals
the spotlight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Deciding to visit the training course once
more, I spot Mejiro
McQueen running
down the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: No... I can do much better than that!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Hey, thought I spotted you—McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, Ryan. Did you need something
of me?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
No, not really. I just saw you running from
over there...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
McQueen, you've got moxie, but don't
you think you're overdoing it a
bit? That
tryout race must have you beat...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the concern, but I'm going to
keep going for a little
longer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: McQueen, you...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
My rivals in today's tryout race were of
much higher caliber than I
anticipated.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I shouldn't have underestimated anyone. I knew that Академия Тайсен is full of talented individuals.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But I can still recover. I'll show everyone
what I am capable of at the
next tryout
race!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be able to call myself a Mejiro
otherwise.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A flame flickers within her eyes as she
proclaims her intentions to
succeed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, if it isn't the new trainer
everyone has been talking about!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
Were any of the students on your mind
after today's tryout races?
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm interested in Мэдзиро МакКуин.

text_block_list.text:
I decide then and there to pay Mejiro
McQueen a visit on the
following day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
